text:
Alyssa Chen: Heads-up — ACME go-live scheduled Fri 11:00 UTC. They warned about an initial 20–40 minute traffic burst. Can we finalize a lightweight warmup + prefill plan? :rocket:
Miguel Torres: Sounds good. Suggest prefill + short warm pool with burst scaling. Need prefill size, batch targets, and streaming fallback decision.
Jonah Patel: Ops checklist: 1) prefill top-ten prompts, 2) prime KV cache, 3) target batch size 8–16, 4) enable streaming fallback for long outputs.
Priya Rao: For the CSM UX, we'll give them a one-line curl prefill and an SDK snippet to opt into streaming. They already have the prompt list.
Alyssa Chen: Miguel — what's your warm pool recommendation (don't want to waste GPUs)?
Miguel Torres: Estimating peak RPS ~120, avg tokens ~250, aim p95 <400ms. Baseline: 2 g5.2x replicas for steady state, warm to 6 for first 20m with burst TTL. That should cover batching headroom.
Theo Williams: From SRE: set autoscale burst TTL=20m, cooldown=5m. Add a route fallback to a smaller quantized model to reduce 503 risk.
eng-sre-oncall: Added alerts: queue_depth > 300 for 5m, tail_latency > 800ms for 5m. Creating incident runbook entry scoped to tenant.
Jonah Patel: I'll run the prefill job. Planned customer-facing curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acme","prompts":["<prompt1>","<prompt2>","...","<prompt10>"]}'
```
Priya Rao: Recommend clients enable streaming: `stream: true` and set client timeout ~10s for perceived latency improvements. We'll include an SDK example.
Alyssa Chen: Console quick toggles for batching?
Miguel Torres: Console -> Dedicated -> Model -> config: `max_batch_tokens`: 8192, `batch_timeout_ms`: 15, `target_batch_size`: 12. Conservative defaults for chat traffic.
Theo Williams: Add cost telemetry check: if token cost spikes >2x baseline during first 30m, trigger alert and rollback policy.
Priya Rao: I'll create a 5-question feedback form for ACME post-go-live: NPS, perceived latency, unexpected failures, prompt drift, suggestions. Short link included in handoff.
Alyssa Chen: Can someone condense this into a 1‑pager for the CSM with the prefill curl, console toggles, and thresholds?
Jonah Patel: I'll draft the 1-pager and drop it in the CS workspace; will ping ACME with the prefill instructions. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Reserved deploy window Fri 10:30–12:00 UTC. Canary enabled.
Alyssa Chen: Great — if errors spike, @eng-sre-oncall and I'll join the bridge. :phone:
eng-sre-oncall: Watching metrics. Will escalate if alerts fire.
Miguel Torres: Post-go-live ops: scale down to baseline 2 replicas after 30m; keep prefill cache TTL=10m to avoid long-tail cost.
Priya Rao: Added feedback link to the handoff doc and included the short SDK snippet.
Alyssa Chen: We'll run a 24‑hour health check next morning to assess onboarding success and renewal risk.
Jonah Patel: Copy.
Priya Rao: :thumbsup:
